source.basis: Industry value-chain template + curated product/market rivals for US mega-cap ≥$100B expansion. Not a live supplier API dump. Gemini drafts were unavailable (billing); content is template-curated with automated schema/繁中 gates and spot review on NVDA/MSFT/JPM. Preview-before-merge.
source.notes_zh: 本頁為產業價值鏈模板＋人工策展競爭對手的種子資料（美股市值≥1,000億美元批次）。未呼叫即時供應商 API；FMP 同業名單不作價值鏈依據。角色與排序依公開產業結構整理，非完整供應商名單或採購份額。競爭對手採產品／市場真實對手原則（參考 AAPL 教訓：不以跨業巨頭充當直接產品對手）。Gemini 草稿因帳單不可用，改走策展模板＋審核閘。
source.notes_en: Industry value-chain template plus curated rivals for the US mcap≥$100B batch. No live supplier API. FMP peers are not used as the value chain. Roles/ranks follow a public industry structure — not a full BOM or spend share. Competitors follow true product/market rivalry (AAPL lesson). Gemini drafts unavailable due to billing; curated templates + review gates used instead.
source.competitorRationale_zh: 競爭弧只列與該公司主力產品／市場重疊的對手；供應鏈階段玩家與競爭對手分開。
source.competitorRationale_en: Rival arc lists product/market overlaps only; stage players are separate from rivals.
references: AAPL curated seed shape on main (schema reference)
